mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 2% signals a loosening of monetary policy, which typically leads to increased liquidity in the market and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in more than 40% of instances when FEDFUNDS is below 2%, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in a month signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE increases by more than 0.5%, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) for two consecutive months indicates weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 50% of instances when RSAFS declines for two consecutive months, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 2% in a month signals supply chain disruptions, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO declines by more than 2%, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: An always-on signal where a low inflation rate (CPIAUCSL) below 2% indicates a stable economic environment, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces negative 60-day returns in more than 40% of instances when CPIAUCSL is below 2%, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: An interaction-driven signal where an increase in unemployment (UNRATE) coupled with a decrease in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) signals a weakening labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 50% of instances when both UNRATE increases and PAYEMS decreases, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: A regime-conditional signal where a decline in housing starts (HOUST) during a period of rising interest rates (FEDFUNDS) indicates a cooling housing market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in more than 50% of instances when HOUST declines and FEDFUNDS increases, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: An interaction-driven signal where a decline in industrial production (INDPRO) coupled with a rise in consumer prices (CPIAUCSL) signals stagflation, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in more than 50% of instances when INDPRO declines and CPIAUCSL increases, the hypothesis is rejected.
